I told Dana the deadline is 19 November, in a thread on her message in #north-team.

On 14 Oct Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team, and I acknowledged that date there. Later the same day he corrected it to 19 November in #north-random, saying he'd read the wrong line the first time. Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could already see the correction, and a signing deadline isn't a finance figure.

The 21 December post and my earlier reply still stand uncorrected in #north-team. Marcus hasn't posted the correction there himself.
